capabilities.description: Reference-library API for reading and updating Zotero items, collections, tags, and attachments metadata.

pricing.free_tier: API access is free; storage plans are separate.

usage_terms.license: Public Web API; clients must handle backoff and 429 responses.

data_governance.retention: User-controlled library data; deletion/export governed by Zotero account controls.
data_governance.lock_in_notes: Strong portability through standard citation formats.

metrics.name: reference_portability
metrics.benchmark: Supports structured library export and standard bibliographic formats

sla.rate_limit: Backoff and 429 Retry-After headers; clients should generally use no more than 4 concurrent requests.

conditions: write, delete, or overwrite user library items
approval.human_readable: Read-only lookup is low risk; library writes should require user confirmation.

provenance.notes: Verified API access, backoff/429 behavior, and concurrency guidance from official Zotero Web API docs.
